summary: Teacher advocates for preserving E-Rate program to ensure reliable broadband access for students in their community.

claims.argument: E-Rate is essential infrastructure for modern public education, providing recurring cost of connectivity
claims.evidence_quote: Morton High School Dist 201 has received $1.38 million in committed federal E-Rate support over funding years 2021–2025 — an average of roughly $275,351 a year toward the connections our students depend on.
